name: Jremreo 2-in-1 Magnetic & Clip-On Phone Cooler
benefit_line: Dual magnetic and clip-on mounting keeps your phone cool without needing a MagSafe case.
benefits: Includes removable back clip and magnetic ring
Compact fan clears fingers during horizontal grip
Quick USB plug-in chill for everyday matches
best_for: Casual and mid-length sessions on any phone with or without a magnetic case.
trade_off: Modest cooling headroom compared to higher-wattage Peltier units.

name: NEVEIKA Plug-in Phone Cooler
benefit_line: Steady semiconductor cooling that prevents mid-match thermal throttling.
benefits: Direct USB-C plug-in power for non-stop cooling
Spring clip fits most phones without magnets
Quiet fan blade design for voice chat clarity
best_for: Ranked sessions where consistent 60 to 120 FPS frame pacing matters most.
trade_off: Requires staying connected to a USB power cable while playing.

name: Black Shark Magnetic Phone Cooler 6 Pro
benefit_line: High-wattage TEC cooling built for sustained max-settings gaming and Beast Mode.
benefits: Large contact plate pulls heat rapidly from the SoC zone
Strong magnetic lock with detachable grip brackets
Smart thermal regulation reduces condensation buildup
best_for: Heavy 3D titles at 120Hz or marathon sessions in warm rooms.
trade_off: Needs a 27W+ USB-C wall adapter or power bank to reach peak cooling.

name: Magnetic Tablet Cooler for iPad, Surface Pro & Samsung Tab
benefit_line: Wide-surface magnetic semiconductor plate engineered specifically for large tablet backplates.
benefits: Expanded cooling pad covers larger tablet processor zones
Magnetic attachment keeps tablet stands and grips unobstructed
Maintains stable brightness and frame rates on big screens
best_for: Tablet gamers playing high-frame-rate shooters or RPGs on a desk stand.
trade_off: Too wide for compact smartphones; requires external USB-C power.

name: SZYUYU Switch Wireless Controller
benefit_line: Lightweight Bluetooth gamepad with full button layout for quick tabletop play.
benefits: Pairs over Bluetooth with Android and Switch layouts
Familiar dual-stick and D-Pad ergonomics
Built-in rechargeable battery for wireless play
best_for: Entry-level Console Mode navigation and casual controller-supported games.
trade_off: Digital triggers rather than long-travel analog triggers.

name: abxylute C6 Wireless Controller
benefit_line: Crisp sticks and responsive wireless polling tuned for multi-platform and mobile cloud play.
benefits: Smooth thumbstick centering for accurate aim tracking
Multi-mode wireless connectivity for phone, tablet and PC
Tactile face buttons and contoured grips for long sessions
best_for: Gamers switching between GMAX Console Mode on Android and PC gaming.
trade_off: Requires a separate desk stand or phone clip since it is a standalone controller.

name: C8 Pro Wireless Controller
benefit_line: Full-featured pro controller with precision sticks and customizable ergonomics.
benefits: High-precision analog sticks and triggers for shooters and racers
Solid full-size grip reduces hand fatigue during long sessions
Works seamlessly with GMAX real-time controller input overlay
best_for: Competitive controller players using landscape Big Screen Console Mode.
trade_off: Heavier in a backpack than slim mobile-only pads.

name: Joso Wireless Mobile Gaming Controller
benefit_line: Stretch-to-fit Bluetooth cradle that turns your phone into a handheld console.
benefits: Telescopic bridge holds phones securely in landscape
Wireless Bluetooth pairing leaves the USB-C port free
Slim profile slips easily into a jacket pocket
best_for: Everyday handheld gaming on the go without removing slim phone cases.
trade_off: Bluetooth connection adds a few milliseconds compared to direct USB-C pads.

name: Mocagen MC1 Phone Controller for Android & iPhone
benefit_line: Balanced handheld grip with responsive sticks and reliable multi-device compatibility.
benefits: Ergonomic curved handles feel like a dedicated handheld
Accurate thumbsticks and shoulder bumpers for action titles
Fits modern wide-screen Android phones securely
best_for: Daily handheld gaming across native Android games, emulators and cloud streaming.
trade_off: Blocks the rear center of the phone, so clip-on coolers cannot mount at the same time.

name: 8BitDo Ultimate Mobile Gaming Controller
benefit_line: Console-grade thumbsticks, refined D-Pad and pro back paddles built for mobile.
benefits: Precision anti-drift thumbsticks and classic tactile D-Pad
Two programmable rear buttons for jump/slide combos
Full-sized sculpted grips for zero cramping
best_for: Players who want console-quality sticks and D-Pad precision on mobile.
trade_off: Larger footprint than pocket-sized telescopic controllers.

name: Mikirini 13-in-1 PUBG Mobile Phone Triggers (Up to 18mm)
benefit_line: Mechanical shoulder triggers that let you aim, peek and fire with 4 to 6 fingers at once.
benefits: Accommodates thick phones and cases up to 18mm
Crisp micro-switch click feedback with zero Bluetooth pairing needed
13-in-1 kit includes spare touch pads and travel storage tin
best_for: Battle royale and FPS players who prefer touchscreen aiming with physical L1/R1 triggers.
trade_off: Requires positioning your in-game fire and scope HUD buttons under the contact pads.

name: 10 Piece Gaming Finger Sleeves Smooth Touchscreen Glide
benefit_line: Thin conductive weave eliminates thumb friction, sweat drag and missed swipes.
benefits: 10-pack ensures fresh spares for both thumbs and index fingers
Consistent low-friction glide across glass and matte screen protectors
Breathable elastic cuff stays in place without pinching
best_for: Touchscreen FPS, MOBA and rhythm players who want zero thumb stutter.
trade_off: Fabric fibers wear down over weeks of heavy play and need periodic replacement.

name: Razer Barracuda X Wireless Gaming & Mobile Headset
benefit_line: Low-latency USB-C wireless dongle plus Bluetooth for pinpoint footsteps without audio delay.
benefits: Plug-and-play USB-C wireless transceiver bypasses Bluetooth audio lag
Lightweight 250g frame with breathable memory-foam ear cushions
Detachable cardioid mic for clear squad comms or solo travel
best_for: Competitive shooters where hearing directional footsteps immediately is critical.
trade_off: The USB-C dongle occupies your phone's bottom port while plugged in.

name: LISEN Adjustable Aluminum Desk Phone Stand
benefit_line: Weighted aluminum tabletop stand that holds your phone at eye level for Console Mode.
benefits: Height and tilt adjustment reduces neck strain at a desk
Open back clearance leaves room for magnetic phone coolers
Cable pass-through cutout for charging while playing
best_for: Playing in landscape Console Mode with a wireless Bluetooth controller.
trade_off: Built for flat desks and tables rather than bed or couch play.

name: 4K USB 3.0 HDMI-to-USB-C Video Capture Card (1080p 60FPS)
benefit_line: Capture or stream crisp 1080p 60FPS gameplay over USB 3.0 with ultra-low passthrough lag.
benefits: Smooth 1080p 60FPS recording output over high-speed USB 3.0 / USB-C
Compact aluminum housing dissipates heat during long streams
Plug-and-play UVC compatibility without proprietary drivers
best_for: Creators recording external console/PC gameplay or streaming mobile HDMI output.
trade_off: Requires a phone or tablet that supports DisplayPort Alt-Mode / HDMI out if capturing your phone.
